newsitem.title: FRANCE: Press Digest - France - Le Monde April 4.
newsitem.headline: Press Digest - France - Le Monde April 4.

text.p: These are leading stories in the afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- German chancellor Helmut Kohl's declaration that he plans to seek re-election in 1998 reassures supporters of European construction.
-- A planned Suez -Lyonnaise des Eaux merger is to be weighed by the two companies' boards on April 11. Parity is expected to be 41 Suez shares for 20 Lyonnaise shares.
-- Generale des Eaux to sell private clinics subsidiary Generale de Sante to foreign investors.
-- Small and medium-sized arms manufacturers criticise planned restructuring of arms procurement agency DGA on grounds it will make it more difficult for them to have access to contracts.
